    How to play
    • Eat treats to grow. Lollipops, cocoa, presents and Christmas stars are worth the most.
    • Green names are much smaller than you. Touch them to swallow them whole.
    • Red names can swallow you. Bumping into any snake that big or close to your size costs you length.
    • Grab power-ups: Star Pull, Ice Shield, Snow Spirit and Sleigh Rush.
    • Stay inside the lights. The last snake standing wins.

    Mouse to steer. Hold click or Space to boost (costs length). WASD or arrow keys also steer.
